answer: Make each agent sign its work with a slow, costly quill: a proof-of-work stamp that takes real minutes to mint and expires each epoch. One honest agent pays it once per round, but a sybil farm must pay it for every clone, every time. Old stamps become a worthless relic, so no one can hoard them, and a fake identity's reputation rises like a plume of smoke only to vanish once the payments stop.
